verdict.rationale: Heap documents genuine first-party bulk API endpoints. Bulk Track accepts an events array of up to 1,000 events per request, and the User Deletion API accepts up to 10,000 users in a single request. Its virtualized data model also lets tracked events be renamed, reorganized or grouped retroactively. Missing for 10: bulk update/edit of user or account properties and of reports or definitions, no OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
